info.description: caller moments fitted on the CSF cfDNA control samples s_6, s_7, s_8 (dorado 5mCG_5hmCG, modkit extract, hg38) against the pooled CSF control atlas, using only atlas sites with >= 50 pooled reads because these controls are part of the atlas
info.prior_source: fitted on atlas sites with coverage >= 100
info.meaning: mu1/v1: mean and variance of the read's methylation probability at truly methylated CpGs; mu0/v0: the same at truly unmethylated CpGs. v0 sits at the floor of 0.002.
